# CryptographicDiscovery.com

> Primary-source records on cryptographic discovery: documented scope, methods, output formats and source status. No scoring or ranking.

Independent editorial reference. No affiliation with NIST, NCCoE, NSA, ANSSI, ENISA, OWASP, or any standards body, regulatory authority, or certification organization. Not a standard, certification, or compliance scheme. No legal, financial, medical, regulatory or investment advice. No security advice. Research assisted by AI tools, reviewed and validated before publication. Editorial responsibility: XB2. All rights reserved; quotation with attribution and link welcome.
